note: Grades the SKILL.md description, not the body. Negatives are deliberately near-misses that share vocabulary with the skill but need something else — an obviously irrelevant prompt tests nothing. Note that Claude consults skills for substantive tasks and often handles trivial one-step asks directly, so positives are written with real detail.
